capabilities: Show Chinese public holidays and adjusted workdays in sidebar, main-tab, and embedded calendars
Store daily important items as Markdown notes with automatic rollover and an undated inbox
Embed interactive or read-only month calendars in notes via daylane code blocks
Run a customizable focus timer with a draggable mini widget and status bar controls
Insert today's items as wiki links into a daily log
disambiguation: Not just a holiday display; it also manages rollover to-do items and an independent pomodoro timer.
extras: Holiday data covers mainland China only for 2025–2027; workday calculations pause for years lacking official data. Desktop only. Auto-rollover is on by default and modifies past items' dates and rollover counts; default deletion removes the whole note. Includes migration paths from old Calendar Plus markers and the Daylane 0.1 format, plus manual steps to migrate config from the old dev-version plugin ID.
motivation: The author's need for important items with embedded calendars was inspired by Calendar Plus, but they implemented Daymark independently.
problem: Obsidian has no awareness of mainland China's official holidays and adjusted workdays, and no automatic rollover of overdue open items into an inbox.

relations.evidence: Calendar Plus 启发了重要事项与内嵌日历的使用需求；本项目独立实现

summary: Chinese-holiday calendar plugin that tracks daily important items as notes, rolls overdue items forward, and adds a built-in focus timer.
